An Eskimo man had been living for years in northern Canada. After decades of dealing with the long and harsh winters, he decides he has had enough. He straps his snow plow to the top of his car with a sign that says "heading south" and prepares to head out. His neighbor comes by and sees this asking "Why are you strapping the plow to the top of the car?" "I am driving south until nobody knows what one of these things are."

So south he drives. He drives through Michigan, through Illinois, down and down he goes, until reaching Mississippi. It is here while he is gassing up, a person comes to him and asks, "hey mister! What is that thing you have on top of your rig?" Here, he decides is the promise land free of snow.

He buys a house and begins to unpack his things. Feeling settled, he relaxes a bit and prepares to take off the snow plow. He then looks out at the road and sees a car with a black man strapped to the top and a sign that says "heading north."
Short saga of a Polar Gook.
